caption: The drawing features a single, round, brown container or vessel with a slightly flared top and bottom and a narrower middle section. The vessel has two circular blue objects on its top surface. Along the side, there is a depiction of a yellow winged creature, possibly a dragon or griffin, with its wings spread and tail curving along the lower edge. The background of the drawing is plain and light beige, with the artist’s name “Robert Cole” written in black near the bottom right corner. The entire composition centers the vessel, and the colors used are predominantly browns and yellows, with the blue of the circular objects and black accents for shading and detailing.
title: Ink and Pen Stand
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
